targets.query:
from(bucket: "clipify_monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "clipify_vm01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "galleries_total" or r._field == "galleries_published" or r._field == "galleries_draft" or r._field == "galleries_orphanedCurated")

from(bucket: "clipify_monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "clipify_vm01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "galleries_curated" or r._field == "galleries_live" or r._field =~ /^galleries_byLayout_/ )

from(bucket: "clipify_monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "clipify_vm01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "creatorPages_discoverable" or r._field == "creatorPages_unlisted" or r._field == "creatorPages_disabled" or r._field == "creatorPages_showBio")

panels.title: Creator Analytics Cache Health
panels.description: Operational cache/API metrics only. Pageviews, clip opens, playback counts, and resource identifiers are intentionally excluded.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "clipify_monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "clipify_vm01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "analyticsCache_valid" or r._field == "analyticsCache_expired" or r._field == "analyticsCache_apiFailures" or r._field == "analyticsCache_rateLimited" or r._field == "analyticsCache_staleFallbacks")
